TEST_A_FACILITY_HOLDOUT.description: Pure held-out industrial plants and independent non-facility clusters. Evaluates facility identity generalization.

TEST_B_SPATIAL_HOLDOUT.description: Geographically blocked regional holdout. Nearby spatial clusters isolated. Evaluates spatial transferability.

TEST_C_TEMPORAL_HOLDOUT.description: Strict chronological future-time holdout. Trained on earlier telemetry, evaluated on subsequent passes.

TEST_D_HARD_NEGATIVES.description: Curated boundary stress benchmark. 216 high-confusion edge cases (cropland fires adjacent to refineries, mining brush fires, asphalt heating).

TEST_E_OOD_ADVERSARIAL.description: Adversarial out-of-distribution and high-entropy edge cases. Tests automated abstention and uncertainty awareness.
